summary: Frontend-only regression on CSV import feature (Storico) via Expo web preview (Playwright, 390x844). All 9 scenarios PASS. Verified: (1) import-csv-button opens import-confirm-modal with warning text containing 'sostituirà tutti gli episodi'; import-cancel-button dismisses cleanly. (2) import-confirm-button triggers a real file chooser (page.expect_file_chooser); a 3-row valid CSV with quoted comma+double-quote note ("Nota, con ""virgolette"" e virgola"), a multiline-quoted note, and 0/1 booleans is fully parsed — toast reads exactly 'Importati 3 episodi' and the FlatList refreshes to 3 cards. (3) Storage inspection (double-encoded 'episodi_v1') confirms the 2 seeded episodes are soft-deleted (deleted_at set) and 3 fresh rows inserted with correct boolean coercion (treno_bus=true, scuola=true, sport=false) and the CSV-escaped note round-tripped intact ('Nota, con "virgolette" e virgola'). (4) Older export format missing bevuto_poco/riposato_poco/nota is accepted — imported row has bevuto_poco=false, riposato_poco=false, nota=''. (5a) Missing timestamp/scala_mal_di_testa headers → Italian error 'Formato CSV non riconosciuto: mancano le colonne timestamp o scala_mal_di_testa' surfaced in toast; active data unchanged. (5b) Intensity 7 (>5) → Italian error containing 'intensità non valida'; data intact. (5c) Timestamp 'not-a-date' → Italian error 'Riga 2: data/ora non valida ("not-a-date")'; data intact. (6) Round-trip (built export-format CSV from current active episodes and re-imported) preserves exactly the same episodes: count and (timestamp, scala, nota) signatures match; toast 'Importati N episodi' matches N. (7) After the import & delete flow with fresh-dated episodes, Andamento (grafico-screen) renders intensity-chart and stat-count reflects the correct count (verified 1 remaining after delete). (8) Regression: saving a new episode with bevuto_poco and riposato_poco chips persists both flags as true in the web store. (9) Regression: after import, delete-button-{id} + confirm-delete-{id} soft-deletes the imported card and it disappears from the list. Cancelling the modal (import-cancel-button) leaves data intact and produces no error toast. No red-screen errors, no pageerror events. Feature ships clean.
critical_code_review_comments: csv.ts parseCsv: robust RFC 4180 tokenizer correctly handles quoted commas, escaped double-quotes ('""' → '"'), and embedded newlines inside quoted fields — all verified end-to-end via file-chooser injection.

csv.ts parseCsv: header lookup is case-insensitive and trimmed (map(h => h.trim().toLowerCase())), and columns are addressed by name, so column order or missing older columns (bevuto_poco/riposato_poco/nota) is tolerated with sensible defaults (false / '').

csv.ts parseCsv: validation order is (a) required headers first, (b) per-row timestamp via Date.parse, (c) integer scala 0–5. On any Error thrown the import doImport handler in storico.tsx never invokes replaceAllEpisodes, so failed imports leave storage untouched — confirmed by comparing storage snapshots before/after every bad-file scenario.
storico.tsx doImport: pickCsvText returning null (user cancel) is short-circuited BEFORE setImporting(true), so no spinner is stuck and no toast fires — matches spec.

db.ts replaceAllEpisodes: on web path, all currently-active episodes get deleted_at=now and imported rows are pushed with incrementing store.nextId, preserving the soft-delete audit trail (verified 2 seeded rows soft-deleted while 3 new rows became active). On native (SQLite) same via withTransactionSync — atomic, good.

Minor (informational, not a bug): db.ts webLoad calls storage.getItem with fallback '', but storage.setItem JSON.stringifies then db.ts also JSON.stringifies the store, producing a double-encoded 'episodi_v1' in localStorage. Round-trips cleanly (webLoad JSON.parses twice via storage layer + inner parse) — same hygiene note carried over from iteration 3, still no functional impact.

csv.ts pickCsvText: on web it uses asset.file.text() when available and falls back to fetch(asset.uri) — belt-and-braces path is correct; on native it reads via expo-file-system/legacy with UTF8 encoding, matching the BOM-stripping in parseCsv (text.replace(/^\uFEFF/, '')).
seed_data_creation: During run: cleared localStorage['episodi_v1']; seeded 2 baseline episodes via UI (scala 4 + sport + 'seed uno', scala 2 + scuola + algifor + 'seed due'); then verified they were soft-deleted and replaced by the 3-row import CSV. Fresh scala=3 episode with bevuto_poco+riposato_poco chips saved via UI to validate STEP 8. Final state after STEP 9: 1 active imported episode ('imp_b', scala 4, treno_bus).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web URL: https://episode-logger-4.preview.emergentagent.com. Mobile viewport 390x844. To inject a CSV file into the DocumentPicker on web: `async with page.expect_file_chooser() as fc_info: await page.click('[data-testid="import-confirm-button"]', force=True); fc = await fc_info.value; await fc.set_files({"name":"x.csv","mimeType":"text/csv","buffer": csv_bytes})`. localStorage 'episodi_v1' is DOUBLE-encoded — parse with `JSON.parse(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('episodi_v1')))`. TestIDs added this iteration: import-csv-button (header), import-confirm-modal, import-cancel-button, import-confirm-button. Italian error strings surfaced verbatim in toast: 'Formato CSV non riconosciuto: mancano le colonne...', 'Riga N: intensità non valida (deve essere 0–5)', 'Riga N: data/ora non valida (...)'. Environment date is 2026-08-30, so imported episodes with Jan 2026 timestamps fall outside Andamento's default '30 giorni' filter — use current-date timestamps when validating stat-count on the default view. Deep-linking directly to /storico leaves no history so back-button GO_BACK fails (test flow only, not a product bug).
rca_of_issue: No bugs — CSV import feature ships clean. All error paths (missing headers, out-of-range intensity, invalid timestamp, user cancel) correctly preserve existing data; happy paths (valid CSV, older format, round-trip) correctly replace and refresh; regression on chips/delete/chart intact.
